# Height Calculator

> Height Calculator (https://height-calculator.net) — Compare, Convert & Understand Any Height. A free height calculator for babies, boys, girls and adults: check height percentiles against CDC & WHO growth charts, predict a child's adult height from parents' heights, convert between centimeters and feet/inches, and compare heights side by side with true-to-scale visuals. Results are educational estimates, not medical advice.

## Core Tools & Utilities

- [Height Calculator Hub](https://height-calculator.net/height-calculator/): Percentile checks, growth charts, child height prediction and unit conversion in one place.
- [Interactive Height Canvas](https://height-calculator.net/): Side-by-side visual comparison stage with true-to-scale proportions, real-time metric/imperial ruler scaling, customizable silhouettes, and image exports.
- [How to Use Guide](https://height-calculator.net/how-to-use/): Measuring height accurately, converting units, reading percentiles, and understanding growth charts.

## Data Sources & Standards

- Growth references: CDC growth charts (United States, ages 2–20) and WHO Child Growth Standards (birth to age 5, worldwide).
- Child height prediction: mid-parental height method — (father + mother + 13 cm) ÷ 2 for boys, (father + mother − 13 cm) ÷ 2 for girls — with a typical range of about ±8–10 cm (3–4 in). Estimates only, never exact.
- Units: exact international standard (1 inch = 2.54 cm); heights stored in centimeters, convertible on-the-fly to feet and inches.
- Honesty policy: educational estimates, not medical advice. For growth concerns, consult a pediatrician.
- Structured Data: key pages provide Schema.org markup (`FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`, `Article`).
- Neutral ground-line baseline: visual models are grounded uniformly to represent accurate real-world standing perspective without optical distortion.

## Legacy Comparison Directories
